name: Path lights
placement: Along a walkway, aisle or driveway edge, one set (6 lights, 0.9 m apart) per 4.6 m.
modeling: Six identical stakes spaced 0.91 m apart on a line: a thin dark cylinder stake with a small cone ground spike, topped by a glowing glass lantern (small cylinder 0.12 m wide, 0.2 m tall) with a cap disc; join all lanterns into one material.
